description: Minimal CRUD-style tool set grouped by read/write actions. Special operations like GLQL are separate.

tools.name: retrieve_content
tools.description: Read-only access to GitLab content (projects, issues, merge requests, wiki pages, snippets, repository, members, labels, milestones, pipelines, hooks, variables). Actions: 'list_projects', 'get_project', 'list_project_members', 'list_project_hooks', 'get_project_hook', 'list_project_variables', 'get_project_variable', 'list_issues', 'list_issues_global', 'get_issue', 'list_issue_notes', 'get_issue_note', 'list_issue_discussions', 'get_issue_discussion', 'list_issue_award_emoji', 'get_issue_award_emoji', 'list_issue_note_award_emoji', 'get_issue_note_award_emoji', 'list_merge_requests', 'get_merge_request', 'list_merge_request_notes', 'get_merge_request_note', 'list_merge_request_commits', 'list_merge_request_diffs', 'list_merge_request_raw_diffs', 'list_merge_request_pipelines', 'list_merge_request_discussions', 'get_merge_request_discussion', 'list_merge_request_award_emoji', 'get_merge_request_award_emoji', 'list_merge_request_note_award_emoji', 'get_merge_request_note_award_emoji', 'list_wiki_pages', 'get_wiki_page', 'list_snippets', 'get_snippet', 'download_snippet', 'list_snippet_award_emoji', 'get_snippet_award_emoji', 'list_snippet_notes', 'get_snippet_note', 'list_snippet_note_award_emoji', 'get_snippet_note_award_emoji', 'get_file', 'download_file', 'list_repository_tree', 'compare_refs', 'get_commit', 'list_pipelines', 'list_pipeline_jobs', 'get_job', 'get_job_log', 'download_job_artifacts', 'download_job_artifact', 'list_project_labels', 'list_group_labels', 'list_project_milestones', 'list_group_milestones'.

owned.description: Limit by projects explicitly owned by the current user

membership.description: Limit by projects that the current user is a member of

project_id.description: Project ID. Use numeric ID (e.g. '123') or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'group%2Fproject').

slug.description: URL-encoded slug of the wiki page, e.g. 'docs%2Fhome'. Use %2F instead of '/'.

with_content.description: Include wiki page content when listing pages

render_html.description: Return rendered HTML when retrieving a wiki page

issue_iid.description: The internal ID of the issue

merge_request_iid.description: The internal ID of the merge request

award_id.description: The ID of the award emoji

hook_id.description: The ID of the project hook

file_path.description: URL-encoded full path to the file, e.g., 'src%2Findex.js'. Use %2F instead of '/'.

ref.description: Branch name, tag, or commit SHA to read from

job_id.description: Job ID (for get_job, get_job_log, or artifact download)

artifact_path.description: Path to a file inside the job artifacts archive

state.description: Filter by issue or merge request state

scope.description: Filter by scope (issues or merge requests)

search.description: Search projects, issues, or merge requests by title or description

in.description: Search scope for issues or merge requests (title, description, or title,description)

milestone_id.description: Filter by milestone ID or special values like None/Any (issues)

assignee_username.description: Filter by assignee username (single or comma-separated)

wip.description: Filter draft merge requests (yes or no)

non_archived.description: Return items only from non-archived projects

sort.description: Sort results in asc or desc order

updated_after.description: Return items updated on or after the given time (ISO 8601)

updated_before.description: Return items updated on or before the given time (ISO 8601)

created_after.description: Return merge requests created on or after the given time (ISO 8601)

created_before.description: Return merge requests created on or before the given time (ISO 8601)

with_labels_details.description: Include extra label details in list responses

activity_filter.description: Filter issue notes by activity type (all_notes, only_comments, only_activity)

id_after.description: Limit results to projects with IDs greater than the specified ID

id_before.description: Limit results to projects with IDs less than the specified ID

min_access_level.description: Limit to projects with at least the specified access level
